messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The job scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, a decision from the INC-2026-009 review. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-22]
- The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so the notifier is down whenever the bus is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11]
- The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so the webhook dispatcher is down whenever the bus is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2]
- Team Dune observed that the bus' request volume halved after the client rollout. [valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-29]
- Tomasz was off the on-call rotation for team Dune until 2026-03-11, when he took the Dune pager; on 2026-04-14 he handed the pager to Farah. [decision; valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14]
    earlier: Tomasz was off the on-call rotation for team Dune until 2026-03-11, when he took the Dune pager. [decision; valid 2026-03-11 to 2026-04-14; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-11]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-16, Tomasz is off the on-call rotation for team Dune. [decision; valid 2026-01-16 to 2026-03-11; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
- Farah was the primary on-call for team Dune until 2026-03-11, when Tomasz took over the pager; on 2026-04-14 Tomasz handed the pager back to Farah. [decision; valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14]
    earlier: Farah was the primary on-call for team Dune until 2026-03-11, when Tomasz took over the pager. [decision; valid 2026-03-11 to 2026-04-14; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-11]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-16, Farah Haddad is the primary on-call for team Dune. [decision; valid 2026-01-16 to 2026-03-11; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-16]
- Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-18]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team looks after the bus, which the Boreal team looked after until then. [decision; valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
    earlier: The Boreal team looks after the bus. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-24; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- Team Dune noticed that the bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23-2]
- As of 2026-05-27, the bus retains messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. [decision; valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team instead of the Atlas team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- From 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team. [valid 2025-03-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- On 2025-09-16, the Ember team handed the authentication gateway over to the Cinder team. [valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
- Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-01-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-14]
- Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export. [valid 2025-01-21 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-21]
- On 2026-02-10, the Boreal team noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the indexer's owners. [valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2]

Question: When can the event-bus be deployed?

message.reasoning: The question asks when the event-bus can be deployed. Memory says: "Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time." Valid 2025-04-18 to now, no later entry supersedes it. Answer: Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC.
